since.description: Calendar day, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Designations whose LastUpdated is on or after `since` (added or amended; the file carries no delisting markers, so removed records only show as gaps between snapshots), paginated like records_list with the same ETag-pinned cursor, plus the publisher's gov.uk change_history notes dated on or after `since`. Offered because gov.uk publishes dated change notes and the file stamps every record with LastUpdated; the publisher provides no per-record delta or earlier file versions.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addresses` | object[] |  |

| `birth_places` | object[] |  |

| `last_updated` | string | LastUpdated as yyyy-mm-dd. |
| `last_updated_source` | string | LastUpdated as published (dd/mm/yyyy). |

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; carries the pinned publication id, the offset and a fingerprint of the filters.

designation_source.description:
Records designated by the UK or by the UN; records marked UK|UN match either.

Provider reference: allowed values ["UK", "UN"].

entity_type.description:
Individual -> person, Entity -> organization, Ship -> vessel.

Provider reference: allowed values ["person", "organization", "vessel"].

page_size.description:
Records per page (default 100).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500.

regime.description: Case-insensitive substring of RegimeName, e.g. Russia, Afghanistan, Global Human Rights.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The full current list as common sanctions records, one page per call. Each call downloads UK-Sanctions-List.xml (about 22 MB), optionally filters by regime (case-insensitive substring of RegimeName), entity_type and designation_source (UK or UN; UK|UN records match both), and returns records [offset, offset + page_size) of the matches with total_records and total_matches. The cursor pins the publication: a later page whose file has a different ETag fails with invalid_input and the issue code publication_changed instead of mixing versions; restart from the first page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

post.description:
Look up a person, organisation or vessel by name before fetching its record by UniqueID.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Case-insensitive substring search over every Latin name (Name1..Name6 joined) and non-Latin script name in the current file, optionally restricted to an entity_type; returns the first `limit` matches (default 25) with total_matches. The host offers no server-side search (the interactive search site is a different service), so this is an in-memory filter over the downloaded file. An empty result is a legitimate answer.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addresses` | object[] |  |
| `birth_dates` | object[] |  |
| `birth_places` | object[] |  |
| `date_designated` | string | DateDesignated as published (dd/mm/yyyy). |
| `designation_source` | string | DesignationSource as published: UK, UN or UK\|UN. |
| `designation_sources` | string[] |  |
| `email_addresses` | string[] |  |
| `entity_type` | string | IndividualEntityShip mapped: Individual -> person, Entity -> organization, Ship -> vessel; any other value -> other. |
| `entity_type_source` | string | IndividualEntityShip as published. |
| `genders` | string[] |  |
| `identifiers` | object[] | Deduplicated on (scheme, value); the file repeats a passport inside a few records. |
| `last_updated` | string | LastUpdated as yyyy-mm-dd. |
| `last_updated_source` | string | LastUpdated as published (dd/mm/yyyy). |
| `legal_basis` | string[] | The regulations named by RegimeName. |
| `listed_on` | string | DateDesignated as yyyy-mm-dd. |
| `measure_details` | object[] | Every measure with the SanctionsImposedIndicators flag or SanctionsImposed token it comes from; several sources can share one code. |
| `measures` | string[] | The batch measure enum, one entry per code, in the order of measure_details. |
| `names` | object[] |  |
| `nationalities` | string[] |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | The runner's observation stamp; present on the records_get output only (list pages stamp the page). |
| `ofsi_group_id` | string | Legacy OFSI Consolidated List Group ID (OFSIGroupID); empty for roughly a fifth of the records. |
| `organization` | object | EntityDetails when the record is an Entity. |
| `other_information` | string |  |
| `phone_numbers` | string[] |  |
| `positions` | string[] |  |
| `primary_name` | string | The first Name entry whose NameType is Primary Name (case-insensitive), parts Name1..Name6 joined with spaces. |
| `programs` | string[] | The RegimeName (one per designation). |
| `publication_id` | string | The S3 ETag of the XML file this record was read from (MD5 of the file for single-part objects). |
| `regime_name` | string |  |
| `remarks` | string | OtherInformation and UKStatementofReasons joined by a blank line. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `sanctions_imposed` | string[] | The pipe-delimited SanctionsImposed string split into its tokens. |
| `sanctions_imposed_indicators` | object | One boolean per SanctionsImposedIndicators element as published (AssetFreeze, ArmsEmbargo, TargetedArmsEmbargo, TravelBan, TrustServicesSanctions, DirectorDisqualificationSanction...); the set of flags grows with the XSD version. |
| `source_record_id` | string | Namespaced UniqueID, e.g. uksl:AFG0001. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `titles` | string[] |  |
| `uk_statement_of_reasons` | string |  |
| `un_reference` | string | UNReferenceNumber, present when the designation source includes the UN. |
| `unique_id` | string | The file's UniqueID: regime prefix and a sequence number. One real-world person listed under several regimes has several UniqueIDs. |
| `vessel` | object | ShipDetails when the record is a Ship. |
| `websites` | string[] |  |

Before a collection run, to decide whether the list changed since the last publication_id, or to get the file URLs and size for a hand-off.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Cheap version check of the published file: a 1 KB Range read of UK-Sanctions-List.xml (ETag as publication_id and MD5 content hash, Last-Modified as published_at, total size, the file's DateGenerated) and the gov.uk Content API record (public_updated_at, latest change note, attachment list for every published format). The record count is not returned because it needs the whole 22 MB file; records_list reports total_records on every page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content_hash` | object |  |
| `date_generated` | string | The file's <DateGenerated> (dd/mm/yyyy). |
| `date_generated_iso` | string |  |
| `etag` | string |  |
| `files` | object[] | Every published format on sanctionslist.fcdo.gov.uk. Only the XML is read; bytes, content_type and etag are null for the others (fetching them would spend the WAF rate budget). |
| `govuk` | object | Version metadata from the gov.uk Content API record of the publication (www.gov.uk/api/content/government/publications/the-uk-sanctions-list). |
| `last_modified` | string | Last-Modified as sent. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `publication_id` | string | The S3 ETag of UK-Sanctions-List.xml; the key every record and cursor is pinned to. |
| `published_at` | string | Last-Modified of the XML as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `schema` | object | The XSD attachment on gov.uk (assets.publishing.service.gov.uk), when listed. |
| `source_url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
